description: Welcome to the big and tall bash guard department. The Lineage Sport Bashguard 26" is the bike your teenaged self couldn't have imagined. Ready to monster-truck over anything in it's path, with a 90's inspired all chromoly frame, fitted with a replaceable nylon bash guard and chromoly forks with peg bosses for the included smooth alloy pegs. Satin finish double-wall alloy rims, sealed high flange hubs and Kenda Kranium tires to put the power to the ground. Add to that Haro Kneesaver bars, mated with our Lineage and Fusion parts and you get an upsized BMX bike that rides the line between your past and future self.
